patch.value: Admit large CSV imports within declared memory and mutation budgets

Stream initial or full validation before import commitment. Acceptance: a million-row fixture stays under a declared heap cap independent of file size; invalid final rows prevent atomic application; exact counts are distinguished from upper bounds. Reuse CSV mapping and SDK schema/status/transaction capabilities rather than introducing a dialect or journal.

Bounded million-row validation; late invalid rows cause zero atomic writes; exact and bounded estimates; typed SDK and compact CLI; no-git real-data validation; seeded state tests and npm/Bun release gates

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: core public SDK exposes schema/status registries, complete reads and mutation/transaction primitives but no streaming CSV resource admission contract. pm-csv already owns parsing, mapping, schema negotiation and atomic import; pm-beads owns JSONL reconciliation and pm-todos owns todo files. This change adds bounded initial/full resource receipts and an opt-in atomic admission guard, reusing shared row validation. No dialect or journal is introduced. Workspace transactions do not isolate ordinary writers; existing per-write SDK rereads remain required and the final read/write window remains documented.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented read-only csv admit and typed admitCSV with exact full counts, conservative initial lower bounds, mutation upper bounds, fixed field/record/column allocations, SHA-256 source binding and settings drift refusal. Atomic import can opt into the same full pass with --admission; only bounded bytes are materialized and source drift refuses before parsing. Targeted regressions cover late invalid rows, custom status normalization, finite limit fuzzing, all parser split points and every source/settings admission boundary. Million-row fixture is 163000015 bytes; final heap-cap rerun is pending.
